settings.nightRedBody: Keeps your eyes adapted to the dark when you walk to the generator. Works for the whole phone, keyboard included.
settings.nightRedIOS1: Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size → Color Filters → turn on, choose Color Tint, set intensity and hue to maximum.
settings.nightRedIOS2: Accessibility → Accessibility Shortcut → Color Filters. Triple-click the side button to toggle.
settings.nightRedAndroid: Depends on the manufacturer: look for Color correction or Color filter in accessibility settings.
